# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

# CSL Behring

*^{Pictured: CSL manufacturing employee in Australia}*
* [CSL][220]
* [We Are CSL][221]
* [Our Businesses and Products][222]
* [CSL Behring][223]

## Leading the Way on Serious & Rare Diseases

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on
serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver
innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular
and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific
platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to
support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical
needs and help patients lead full lives.

Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs more than 32,000 people, and
delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

[Test tubes]

## CSL Behring Products

We develop and deliver innovative medicines for treating bleeding disorders, immune deficiencies and
chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, as well as hereditary angioedema and Alpha 1
Antitrypsin Deficiency, among others.

[See the CSL Behring Global Product List][224]

## Our Products

[CIDP Patient Arthur standing near a rock wall]

### Achieving better health

CSL Behring's R&D efforts have resulted in a wide range of biotherapy products that have had a
lasting impact on human health around the world.

[Emily and A.J. Bartko]

### Making a difference with one treatment at a time

We bring to market biotherapy products for rare diseases that might not have been produced
otherwise.

[Smith family at a picnic]

### Our commitment and delivering our promise

We are committed to delivering value through fulfilling unmet needs and enhancing patient
experience. Our promise is to protect the health and well-being of people with life-threatening
medical conditions.

[HAE patient Zahra Khan]

## Putting Patients First

Our patients are our passion and that drives the way we work. We are committed to full transparency
of expectations and outcomes when partnering with them. We listen closely to patients about their
experiences and collaborate with them from early research through the delivery of our innovative
medicines.

[Learn More About the Diseases We Treat][225]
[A group shot of the Alpha 1 cycling team from CSL Behring]

## Vita: You Are Not Alone

There is drama and emotion in the promise of biotechnology. We find it in the stories of patients
and their families, and in the persistence and resolve of our researchers. And we see it in the
drive and enduring optimism of our employees, who are committed to delivering on our promise of a
brighter future. Visit our digital storytelling page, Vita, to read inspiring stories.

[Read Vita Stories][226]
[Doctors conferring]

## CSL Behring Events

Attention Healthcare Professionals! CSL Behring participates in congresses and events around the
globe. Want to know more?

[Visit CSLBehringEvents.com][227]
[CSL Plasma]

## CSL Behring Operates CSL Plasma

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, **CSL Plasma**. CSL
Plasma is vertically integrated, meaning plasma collected at CSL Plasma facilities is used by CSL
Behring for the sole purpose of manufacturing and delivering its life-saving therapies to people in
more than 100 countries.

[Learn More About CSL Plasma][228]

# CSL Behring

*^{Pictured: CSL manufacturing employee in Australia}*
* [CSL][220]
* [We Are CSL][221]
* [Our Businesses and Products][222]
* [CSL Behring][223]

## Leading the Way on Serious & Rare Diseases

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on
serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver
innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular
and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific
platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to
support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical
needs and help patients lead full lives.

Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs more than 32,000 people, and
delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

[Test tubes]

## CSL Behring Products

We develop and deliver innovative medicines for treating bleeding disorders, immune deficiencies and
chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy, as well as hereditary angioedema and Alpha 1
Antitrypsin Deficiency, among others.

[See the CSL Behring Global Product List][224]

## Our Products

[CIDP Patient Arthur standing near a rock wall]

### Achieving better health

CSL Behring's R&D efforts have resulted in a wide range of biotherapy products that have had a
lasting impact on human health around the world.

[Emily and A.J. Bartko]

### Making a difference with one treatment at a time

We bring to market biotherapy products for rare diseases that might not have been produced
otherwise.

[Smith family at a picnic]

### Our commitment and delivering our promise

We are committed to delivering value through fulfilling unmet needs and enhancing patient
experience. Our promise is to protect the health and well-being of people with life-threatening
medical conditions.

[HAE patient Zahra Khan]

## Putting Patients First

Our patients are our passion and that drives the way we work. We are committed to full transparency
of expectations and outcomes when partnering with them. We listen closely to patients about their
experiences and collaborate with them from early research through the delivery of our innovative
medicines.

[Learn More About the Diseases We Treat][225]
[A group shot of the Alpha 1 cycling team from CSL Behring]

## Vita: You Are Not Alone

There is drama and emotion in the promise of biotechnology. We find it in the stories of patients
and their families, and in the persistence and resolve of our researchers. And we see it in the
drive and enduring optimism of our employees, who are committed to delivering on our promise of a
brighter future. Visit our digital storytelling page, Vita, to read inspiring stories.

[Read Vita Stories][226]
[Doctors conferring]

## CSL Behring Events

Attention Healthcare Professionals! CSL Behring participates in congresses and events around the
globe. Want to know more?

[Visit CSLBehringEvents.com][227]
[CSL Plasma]

## CSL Behring Operates CSL Plasma

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, **CSL Plasma**. CSL
Plasma is vertically integrated, meaning plasma collected at CSL Plasma facilities is used by CSL
Behring for the sole purpose of manufacturing and delivering its life-saving therapies to people in
more than 100 countries.

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

### [ Pharmaceutical & Medical Supplies Distribution Services ][127]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

### [ Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions ][129]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Read More ][133]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

Join a global community dedicated to reducing the burden of CV disease worldwide and access
resources that help you advance your knowledge and expand your network.

## Benefits

### Start your application today

The ACC unites cardiovascular professionals worldwide under one roof. With member options from your
medical school through retirement and spanning the breadth of the care team, there’s a membership
for you.

Apply Today

cardiovascular professionals, deep discounts on educational opportunities and more.

## 2026 and a pipeline targeting cardiovascular and hematologic indications.
* FDA approved KRESLADI™ in March 2026 under the accelerated approval pathway [sec · filed
  2026-04-06].
* Cash & equivalents of $51.0M as of 2026-03-31; net loss of $47.6M for the quarter ended 2026-03-31
  [sec].
* Accumulated deficit of $1.44 billion as of December 31, 2025 [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].
* Operates a ~100,000 sq. ft. AAV cGMP manufacturing facility in Cranbury, New Jersey [sec · filed
  2026-04-06].
* Strategic focus on rare cardiovascular indications targeting inherited cardiomyopathies affecting
  >100,000 patients in the U.S. and EU [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].

### What works
* First FDA approval (KRESLADI™) validates platform and regulatory pathway [sec · filed 2026-04-06].
* In-house AAV manufacturing facility provides end-to-end control over clinical production and
  scale-up [sec · filed 2026-04-06].
* Leadership team has a track record of over 20 successful drug approvals and launches [sec · filed
  2026-04-06].
* Strategic focus on rare cardiovascular diseases with sizable market opportunities [sec_mda · as of
  2026-02-26].

### What to weigh
* No revenue from product sales yet; net losses and negative cash flows since inception [sec_mda ·
  as of 2026-02-26].
* Cash & equivalents of $51.0M as of 2026-03-31 may require additional financing to fund operations
  [sec].
* Accumulated deficit of $1.44 billion as of December 31, 2025 reflects substantial historical
  losses [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].
* Phase 2 RP-L301 study for PKD is ready but enrollment not initiated due to resource prioritization
  [sec · filed 2025-04-30].

### From the filings

Quoted directly from source documents.
* FDA approval of KRESLADI™ in March 2026
  
  > “On March 27, 2026, Rocket announced FDA approval of KRESLADI™.”
  
  [SEC filings][14] · April 6, 2026
* Accumulated deficit as of December 31, 2025
  
  > “accumulated deficit of $1.44 billion as of December 31, 2025”
  
  [SEC MD&A][15] · February 26, 2026
* Manufacturing facility size and location
  
  > “~100,000 sq. ft. U.S.-based in-house AAV cGMP manufacturing facility in Cranbury, New Jersey”
  
  [SEC filings][16] · April 6, 2026

Risks & what to watch (4)›

### Key risks
* No product revenue yet — Company has not generated revenue from product sales and relies on
  financing to fund operations [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].
* Limited cash runway
* Clinical and regulatory uncertainty — Pipeline candidates require significant additional R&D and
  regulatory approvals; delays or failures could impact value [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].
* Competition and market adoption — Gene therapy market is competitive; KRESLADI™ and other
  candidates face competition from existing and emerging therapies [sec_mda · as of 2026-02-26].

### What to watch
* Commercial launch and revenue generation from KRESLADI™ following FDA approval [sec · filed
  2026-04-06].
* Progress of Phase 2 pivotal trial for RP-A501 in Danon disease after FDA lifted clinical hold [sec
  · filed 2026-04-06].
* Enrollment status and data readouts from ongoing FA subtypes C and G trial [sec · filed
  2025-04-30].
* Potential additional financing or partnership activities to extend cash runway [sec_mda · as of
  2026-02-26].

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.

  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

See community stories][23]

* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

accessibility.

## Formulary

The Devon Formulary promotes safe, effective, and economic prescribing across primary and secondary
care in Devon.

It provides clinical guidance on the management of a wide variety of common conditions, including
locally recommended drug choices presented in a recognisable traffic light classification.

The Devon Formulary is not a restrictive list, but a recommendation drawn up after widespread
consultation with local prescribers and in collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University
Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital),
Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon
Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

##### Drugs A-Z

Browse drug names by A to Z (generically) with hyperlinks to drug entries.

Drug entries describe the medicinal forms, indications, doses, indicative prices, safety updates,
preferred brands where noted, and other considerations involved in the use of a drug included in the
Devon Formulary.

##### Treatment Summaries

The Devon Formulary uses a therapeutic classification system based on the BNF.

Additional chapters, sections, and paragraphs have been created to include appliances/ preparations,
or to further sub classify within existing areas.

[Find out more][35]

##### Shared Care Guidelines

Formal Shared Care agreements which enable continued prescribing and monitoring of specialist
medicines in primary care.

[Find out more][36]

## Referral

The Devon Clinical Referral Guidelines (CRGs) are designed to improve the consistency of clinical
care delivered across Devon by promoting locally agreed clinical advice, pathways of care, and
resources for individual clinical conditions.

The Devon Referral content has been developed in collaboration with local clinicians and in
collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal
Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital), Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation
Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

## Formulary

The Devon Formulary promotes safe, effective, and economic prescribing across primary and secondary
care in Devon.

It provides clinical guidance on the management of a wide variety of common conditions, including
locally recommended drug choices presented in a recognisable traffic light classification.

The Devon Formulary is not a restrictive list, but a recommendation drawn up after widespread
consultation with local prescribers and in collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University
Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital),
Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon
Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

##### Drugs A-Z

Browse drug names by A to Z (generically) with hyperlinks to drug entries.

Drug entries describe the medicinal forms, indications, doses, indicative prices, safety updates,
preferred brands where noted, and other considerations involved in the use of a drug included in the
Devon Formulary.

resources for individual clinical conditions.

##### Treatment Summaries

The Devon Formulary uses a therapeutic classification system based on and closely following the BNF.

Additional chapters, sections, and paragraphs have been created to include appliances/ preparations,
or to further sub classify within existing areas.

[Find out more][35]

##### Shared Care Guidelines

Formal Shared Care agreements which enable continued prescribing and monitoring of specialist
medicines in primary care.

[Find out more][36]

##### Formulary Resources

This section contains links to the websites of other organisations which may be able to provide you
with additional support.

[Find out more][37]

##### Formulary Updates

A summary of the latest formulary changes.

[Find out more][38]

## Referral

The Devon Clinical Referral Guidelines (CRGs) are designed to improve the consistency of clinical
care delivered across Devon by promoting locally agreed clinical advice, pathways of care, and
resources for individual clinical conditions.

The Devon Referral content has been developed in collaboration with local clinicians and in
collaboration with NHS Devon ICB, Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust (Royal
Devon and Exeter Hospital and North Devon District Hospital), Torbay and South Devon NHS Foundation
Trust, University Hospitals Plymouth NHS Trust, Devon Partnership NHS Trust, and Livewell Southwest.

# National Blood Clot Alliance

### National Blood Clot Alliance

The National Blood Clot Alliance (NBCA) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, voluntary health organization
dedicated to advancing the prevention, early diagnosis and successful treatment of life-threatening
blood clots such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and clot-provoked stroke.

NBCA works on behalf of people who may be susceptible to blood clots, including people with clotting
disorders, atrial fibrillation, cancer, traumatic injury, and risks related to hospitalization and
surgery, lengthy immobility, childbirth, and hormonal birth control.

NBCA accomplishes its mission through programs that build public awareness, educate patients and
healthcare professionals, and promote supportive public sector policy.


NBCA has earned Candid’s Platinum Seal of Transparency. [Read more][191].

chest suffocating me." She almost dismissed it as a pulled muscle or anxiety from her recent move to

she's still navigating the emotional weight of an unprovoked diagnosis: the anxiety that spikes with

[ 💙 "This has been the most serious medical event of [💙 "This has been the most serious medical
event of my 60 years. I am grateful to have survived and to still be here with my family." Teresa
Adams wrote those words after surviving a pulmonary embolism on her birthday, months after being
diagnosed with a DVT. No cause was ever found and she will likely be on blood thinners for life. Now

[ 🌡️🚨 Millions of Americans are under extreme heat a [🌡️🚨 Millions of Americans are under extreme
heat alerts this week. Beyond the obvious heat safety tips, here's something we don't talk about
enough: dehydration may increase your risk for blood clots. How? 🤔 When you're dehydrated 🥵, your
blood volume drops and your blood becomes thicker and more concentrated 🩸 — making it harder for
your body to keep circulation moving smoothly, especially in your legs. On top of that, extreme heat
☀️ often means people move less, staying indoors 🏠 and avoiding activity to stay cool. Less
movement = more time for blood to pool in the vein

# National Blood Clot Alliance

### National Blood Clot Alliance

The National Blood Clot Alliance (NBCA) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, voluntary health organization
dedicated to advancing the prevention, early diagnosis and successful treatment of life-threatening
blood clots such as deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and clot-provoked stroke.

NBCA works on behalf of people who may be susceptible to blood clots, including people with clotting
disorders, atrial fibrillation, cancer, traumatic injury, and risks related to hospitalization and
surgery, lengthy immobility, childbirth, and hormonal birth control.

NBCA accomplishes its mission through programs that build public awareness, educate patients and
healthcare professionals, and promote supportive public sector policy.


NBCA has earned Candid’s Platinum Seal of Transparency. [Read more][191].

## Dr. Karin Halvorson

[[Dr. Karin Halvorson]][115]

Dr. Karin Halvorson earned her medical degree from the University of Hawaii. She completed a
combined residency in Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine at the University of Illinois at
Chicago. Subsequently she attended Brown University for her Pulmonary and Critical Care Fellowship.
While at Brown she was inducted into the Alpha Omega Alpha Honor Society and earned the 2014 Fellow
Teaching Award. She served as the liaison between the emergency department and the intensive care
unit during her time at Brown.

Dr. Halvorson is the Medical Director of Critical Care at Tulane University Medical Center where she
splits her time between the MICU and the ED. Dr. Halvorson’s research interests are on ED to ICU
transitions and optimizing early critical care. She is also invested in [medical education][116] and
works with Housestaff on Quality Improvement Projects for Tulane University Medical Center.
